step1_analysis.circuit_type: Bias Generator / Diode-Connected Stack (Sub-circuit of VCO)
step1_analysis.description: A DC bias generation circuit consisting of an NMOS current source (XM1) driving a diode-connected stack of parallel PMOS (XM2, XM3) and NMOS (XM4, XM5) transistors. It generates reference voltages at nodes N0 and N1, likely used to bias the core of the Colpitts VCO.

operating_frequency.description: Oscillation frequency of the full VCO circuit

sky130_expected.calculation: N/A for this specific bias sub-circuit. Applies to the full LC tank VCO.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Target frequency based on the paper's reported metric for the complete oscillator.

efficiency.description: DC-to-RF power conversion efficiency of the full VCO

sky130_expected.reasoning: Reported metric for the full VCO.

gain.description: Gain of the active cross-coupled pair or output buffer in the full VCO

sky130_expected.reasoning: Reported metric for the full VCO.

dc_current.description: DC current flowing through the bias stack

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming BIAS = 0.6V. XM1 (W/L=10) is in saturation: Id = 0.5 * 270u * 10 * (0.6 - 0.42)^2 = 43.7 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using SKY130 NMOS parameters with a 0.6V bias input.

v_n0.description: DC voltage at node N0 (gate/drain of the diode-connected stack)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Voltage drop across the diode-connected PMOS load.

v_n1.description: DC voltage at node N1 (source of XM4/XM5, drain of XM1)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Voltage drop across the diode-connected NMOS load.

power_consumption.description: DC power consumed by the bias circuit

sky130_expected.reasoning: Product of the 1.8V supply and the calculated DC current.

step3_testbench.description: DC operating point analysis to measure the bias currents and generated reference voltages at nodes N0 and N1.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Bias Generator Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VBIAS BIAS 0 0.6
VGND GND 0 0

XM1 N1 BIAS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 N0 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N0 N0 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}

.control
op
let id = -i(VVDD)
let pwr = id * 1.8
let vn0 = v(N0)
let vn1 = v(N1)

print id
print pwr
print vn0
print vn1
quit
.endc
